messages:
Matt: quick sync before RFC update — want to standardize a 'soft fallback' signal across adapters. proposing adapters return status not just Optional/Route>.
Sara: yes. today nil==hard fallback which hides 'acceptable-but-not-preferred'.
Jin: what's the shape? worried about perf carrying metadata.
Matt: proposal: policy.evaluate(...) -> { status: accept | soft_fallback | hard_fallback, candidate?: Route, reason_enum?: string, priority_delta?: int }
Ben: so runtime can still pick it and annotate traces/tokens, and telemetry knows fallback type. nice.
Carla: prefer enums for reasons to avoid drift: capacity_limited, latency_degraded, quantized_quality_drop.
Sara: enum + optional freeform for debug logs. telemetry records enum only.
Jin: perf-wise this is tiny: a byte + small ints. fine.
Ben: migration? many v1 adapters return Optional/Route>.
Matt: runtime will accept both. v1 adapters map nil -> hard_fallback via shim. v2 can emit soft_fallback.
Carla: tests: ordering when soft_fallbacks present; ensure canary doesn't oscillate.
Sara: ops request metric soft_fallback_rate per tenant/model/region and alert >5% over 5m on prod tiers.
opssentry-bot: deploy-log: canary policy-engine:v2 deployed to sandbox 2024-05-01T09:12:03Z.
Jin: rollout plan: Dedicated first, then hosted. run 24h sim with recent traces to spot thrash.
Matt: next steps: Sara prototype v2 adapter + shim tests (Thu); Jin add telemetry fields + sim harness (Fri); Carla enumerate enums and map current reasons (Thu); Ben update docs + migration checklist (Mon).
Sara: assigned, opening PR for adapter types and short spec.
Ben: I'll draft docs and checklist.
Carla: posting mapping doc to #architecture by EOD.
Matt: open Q: should policy->runtime expose priority_delta so SLA can override route ordering?
Jin: propose optional priority_delta:int (negative -> prefer more, positive -> deprioritize). default 0 for accept, maybe +10 for soft_fallback. runtime honors SLA override.
Sara: keep optional; runtime ignores when tenant SLA == strict.
Matt: consensus: include reason_enum and optional priority_delta. add to RFC and rollout plan.
opssentry-bot: note: created ticket INF-1427 "policy-engine adapter v2 + soft_fallback rollout" assigned to @Sara @Jin @Carla @Ben.
Matt: thanks all, ping when PR is ready and I'll update the RFC.
Sara: will do, thanks!
